nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time between 30 and 60 seconds from now, the parking completion event shall equal 1.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 30 秒到第 60 秒之间，泊车完成事件应至少有一个时刻为 1。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The parking maneuver shall be recorded as complete at least once during the window from 30 to 60 seconds.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 泊车操作应在第 30 秒至第 60 秒的窗口内至少有一个时刻被记录为完成。
